activity_summary: Field sold you the Plutarch at fourteen shillings unbound, and asked his Holinshed home by Whitsun. You paid the fourteen and promised nothing about Whitsun. A turned letter was ringed, and his thumb was the one on the ring. You asked what becomes of an error once enough copies have escaped. He said it acquires company. The next sheet was Theseus, with an Amazon queen. You said a few lines would stay and that you were not starting a play from them. He said it is market day at home, and he never passes a Thursday but he knows it. You carried the sheets off flat. Jacqueline told you to move the dripping paper. You did not promise a day for the chronicle.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: Priced the sheets, named the error's fate, and asked for the Holinshed without getting a day.

entities.name: Jacqueline Field
entities.context: Moved the talk off her floor, and refused a promise made only to fill a silence.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Paid, promised nothing, and carried the sheets flat.

facets.activity: Paid fourteen shillings for the unbound sheets

quotes.speaker: richard_field
quotes.text: Fourteen shillings to you, unbound, and my Holinshed home by Whitsun

quotes.speaker: richard_field
